attchmntText: The Ruby Mills Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Cessation of  Rishabh Viraj Shah as President of the company w.e.f. November 12, 2026.
voiceSummary: Ruby Mills Limited announced board decisions on November 12, 2026. The board approved the appointment of Shri Siddharth S. Thacker, DIN 07282347, as Additional Director and Independent Director for five years from November 12, 2026, to November 11, 2031, subject to shareholder approval. Shri Rishabh Viraj Shah ceased as President effective November 12, 2026. He was appointed as Additional Director and Whole Time Director for three years from November 12, 2026, to November 11, 2029, subject to shareholder approval. Shri Sunil Kumar Tyagi was appointed as Chief Operating Officer and Senior Management Personnel effective November 23, 2026. The board meeting commenced at 6:07 p.m. and concluded at 9:00 p.m.

attchmntText: The Ruby Mills Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: The Ruby Mills Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was 10,496.17 lakhs for the quarter and 19,644.39 lakhs for the half year. Profit for the period stood at 5,084.16 lakhs for the quarter and 6,266.65 lakhs for the half year. The board placed the appointment of Shri Siddharth S. Thacker as Additional Director and Independent Director for five years from November 12, 2026, subject to shareholder approval. Shri Rishabh Viraj Shah ceased as President on November 12, 2026. His appointment as Additional Director and Whole Time Director for three years is also subject to shareholder approval. Shri Sunil Kumar Tyagi was appointed Chief Operating Officer effective November 23, 2026.
